findings.issue: The journal explicitly states a worldwide no-fee route and permits human-revised drafting and verified data-analysis assistance, but the checklist caps AI-generated text at 12%.
findings.resolution: Retain compatible conditional workflow and disclose the quantitative limit.

findings.issue: The journal states a worldwide no-fee policy and addresses AI use for writing, collection, and analysis with human oversight. Its journal-wide citation count is a snapshot, not acceptance probability.
findings.resolution: Retain compatible conditional workflow and label citation snapshot.

findings.issue: Official policy confirms no-fee processing but limits AI to supportive language functions; location and author eligibility remain unestablished.
findings.resolution: Retain prohibited classification and unknown geography.

findings.issue: The author-guidelines URL timed out on independent web retrieval; the fee reviewer reports a snippet while the AI reviewer reports a successful page read. Disclosure alone cannot establish substantive permission.
findings.resolution: Retain needs_verification fee and unclear AI classifications pending readable policy verification.

findings.issue: Sage permits generated research code and conditional generated text with disclosure, but prohibits AI analysis of experiences and themes. The journal gives a first-decision average without a period or denominator.
findings.resolution: Retain qualified AI compatibility and label timing limits; do not infer acceptance rate.

findings.resolution: Retain dated foundation basis and conditional compatibility; label 2018 impact factor historical.
